# Security Policy

## Reporting Vulnerabilities

If you discover a security vulnerability, please open an issue on this repository
or email the maintainer directly.

## Threat Model

See [docs/SECURITY.md](../docs/SECURITY.md) for the full threat model, permissions
audit, encryption design, and data handling practices.

## Encryption

StickySites offers opt-in AES-256-GCM encryption at rest for all note data.
See the security documentation for implementation details.
